# Demo corpus (Phase 2)

A synthetic research-publisher site used by the Phase 2 content-intelligence evals, by later
recommendation fixtures (Phase 3), and by the planned end-to-end demo (`make demo`).

**It is entirely synthetic and fictional.**
- The site is `https://research.example.com/`, an IANA-reserved example domain. It is never a real
  Ken Research URL.
- External links point only at `*.example.org` / `*.example.net`.
- Every company comes from the fixture taxonomy gazetteer (`policies/taxonomy/taxonomy.v1.yaml`):
  Voltara Motors, Sunvale Energy, Corecell Batteries, Nimbus Semiconductors, MedAxis Devices,
  Zorvex Pay and ColdPath Logistics. All of them are fictional.
- Market figures and forecasts are illustrative prose, not research findings.
- There is no production data and there are no secrets.

## Files

| File | What it is |
|---|---|
| `research_site.jsonl` | 65 pages in the JSONL export format v1 (docs/CONTRACTS.md §13): one `ExportHeader` line, then one `ExportPageRecord` per page. |
| `relatedness.json` | 98 labelled, unordered page pairs: 49 `strong`, 20 `weak`, 29 `unrelated` (including at least 15 hard negatives). Each has a one-line rationale. Also holds the rubric and the retrieval `pool` (46 pages). |
| `analysis_expected.json` | Spec-derived goldens for all 65 pages: page type, intent, market, industry, expected geographies and entities, protection rules, and eligibility with reasons. |

## Corpus inventory

| Kind | Count | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Market reports `/industry-reports/<slug>` | 39 | 36 regular reports (250–700 words), plus three special cases |
| Insights `/insights/<slug>` | 14 | 11 regular insights (250–370 words), plus three special cases |
| Hubs | 7 | `/`, `/industry-reports`, `/insights`, `/industries/{automotive,energy,healthcare,technology}` |
| Corporate / legal / contact | 5 | `/about`, `/careers`, `/privacy`, `/terms`, `/contact` |

The special cases:
- **Drafts** (`publication_state: draft`): `/industry-reports/vietnam-ev-charging-market` and
  `/insights/solid-state-batteries-outlook`.
- **CMS-protected** (`metadata.cms_protected: "true"`):
  `/industry-reports/saudi-arabia-medical-devices-market`.
- **Legal pages:** `/privacy` and `/terms`, protected by path rule.
- **Thin pages** (< 60 words): `/industry-reports/qatar-insurance-market` (29 words) and
  `/insights/webinar-recap-october` (23 words).
- **Mid-length page:** `/insights/q3-market-update` (82 words). It is long enough to be a target
  (60 words) but too short to be a source (120 words).
- **Canonical alias:** `/industry-reports/india-electric-two-wheeler-market-2025-edition` declares
  `/industry-reports/india-electric-two-wheeler-market` canonical.

The pages carry existing internal links as absolute `https://research.example.com/...` hrefs,
mostly report ↔ insight, plus a few external links. They also deliberately contain many natural
**unlinked mentions** of other pages' topics. Phase 3 recommendation fixtures need these. Examples:

| Page | Unlinked mention | Page that covers it |
|---|---|---|
| India electric vehicle report | "charging infrastructure", "lithium-ion battery cells", "auto parts" | India EV charging, India Li-ion manufacturing, India auto components |
| India electric two-wheeler report | "charging infrastructure", "Battery swapping", "lithium-ion battery" | India EV charging, battery-swapping insight, India Li-ion |
| Vietnam solar report | "energy storage", "perovskite solar cells", "offshore wind" | storage reports, perovskite insight, Vietnam wind |
| India EV charging report | "battery storage", "rooftop solar" | India battery energy storage, India rooftop solar |
| India pharmaceutical report | "cold chain" | India cold chain |
| Malaysia semiconductor report | "data centers in Johor" | Malaysia data center |
| India Li-ion report | "solid-state batteries" | the solid-state **draft**: a negative, since a draft is never a target |

## How it is used

- `tests/unit/intelligence_evals/test_analysis_goldens.py`: analysis, protection and eligibility
  goldens, plus corpus invariants.
- `tests/unit/intelligence_evals/test_retrieval_eval.py`: offline retrieval metrics with
  regression floors.
- `evals/intelligence/benchmark.py`: the mock vs local-Ollama embedding benchmark.

See [`evals/intelligence/README.md`](../../../evals/intelligence/README.md).

## Regenerating

The JSONL is generated by `evals/intelligence/build_demo_corpus.py`. The text there is data, with no
randomness. The output is committed.

```bash
.venv/bin/python evals/intelligence/build_demo_corpus.py          # rewrite research_site.jsonl
.venv/bin/python evals/intelligence/build_demo_corpus.py --check  # CI: committed file is current
```

`relatedness.json` and `analysis_expected.json` are hand-maintained goldens. Write them from
ADR-0010 and the taxonomy **before** running the code, never by pasting implementation output.
Changing an existing label or golden is a reviewed decision: cite the rule that justifies it.
